craftsmanship.section_subtitle: Every piece of furniture we create is a work of art that marries Arabic heritage with international standards

points.title: Made to Order
points.description: We never produce duplicates. Every project begins from scratch to suit your unique space and taste.

points.title: Master Artisans
points.description: Our team of expert carpenters and upholsterers brings over twenty years of experience in luxury furniture making.

points.title: Quality Guaranteed
points.description: We uphold the highest quality standards at every stage of manufacturing with a comprehensive warranty on all products.

materials.section_subtitle: We source the finest materials from around the globe to ensure furniture that endures and grows more beautiful with time

items.title: Natural Hardwoods
items.description: American walnut, European oak, and carefully treated beechwood
items.detail: Kiln-dried and treated for local climate resilience

items.title: Premium Fabrics
items.description: Italian velvet, Turkish chenille, and stain-resistant textiles with colorfast dyes
items.detail: UV and fade resistant for lasting beauty

items.title: Metals and Finishes
items.description: Brushed gold, antique brass, and stainless steel with hand-applied finishes

items.title: Cushioning and Support
items.description: High-density foam with engineered dimensions for optimal comfort that lasts years
items.detail: Resistant to sagging with daily use

process.section_subtitle: A thoughtful journey from concept to completion ensuring an exceptional experience at every step

steps.title: Consultation
steps.description: We visit your site to understand the space, listen to your vision, and present our initial recommendations

steps.title: Design
steps.description: We prepare 3D renderings with material and color selections until we achieve the result you desire

steps.title: Manufacturing
steps.description: Our team executes the project in our fully equipped workshop under direct quality supervision

steps.title: Installation
steps.description: We handle professional delivery and installation at your site, verifying every detail before handover
